+                [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "main.py"), str(path), *arguments],
+                text=True,
+                capture_output=True,
+                check=False,
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), contents)
+            return result
+

+        result = self.run_cli(
+            'name,note,kind\r\n"A, B","first\nsecond",x\r\nC,plain,y\r\n',
+            "--where",
+            "kind=x",
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            json.loads(result.stdout),
+            [{"name": "A, B", "note": "first\nsecond", "kind": "x"}],
+        )
+
+    def test_grouped_decimal_aggregation_is_sorted(self):
+        result = self.run_cli(
+            "group,amount\nz,0.1\na,1.00\nz,0.2\n",
+            "--group-by",
+            "group",
+            "--sum",
+            "amount",
+            "--avg",
+            "amount",
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
+        self.assertEqual(

+            ],

+

+        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, 'a,b\n"x,y","line 1\nline 2"\n')

+        cases = [

+            (
+                "g,n\nx,nope\n",
+                ("--group-by", "g", "--sum", "n"),
+                "row 2, column 'n'",
+            ),

+                self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+                self.assertIn(message, result.stderr)

+
